skill.name: vowel
skill.description: Create and edit Vowel static websites from Markdown files or Obsidian vaults, with guidance for pages, settings, validation, and deployment.
skill.summary: Build Markdown websites with Vowel using structured pages, inherited settings, local previews, and validation.
skill.author: samlfair

content.value_statement: Markdown websites need consistent page structure, navigation, and publishing settings. This skill guides AI assistants through Vowel authoring, validation, previews, exports, and approved deployment.
actual_capabilities: Guide creation of Vowel homepages, section indexes, and settings files.
Apply page metadata conventions for titles, dates, images, descriptions, and publication status.
Use file links, wikilinks, tags, alerts, and filtered page listings.
Configure inherited site settings and customize appearance through project stylesheets.
Guide validation with vowel check and local preview startup.
Guide static exports and Cloudflare Pages deployment with explicit publication approval.
limitations: Requires an external Vowel installation or npx execution and Node.js 26 or later.
Provides instructions only; the reviewed skill does not include the Vowel runtime.
Vowel drops HTML inside Markdown; generated build output should not be edited.
Hidden pages and hashed URLs do not protect sensitive content.

use_cases.title: Create a personal Markdown blog
use_cases.description: Organize dated posts, section indexes, tags, and feed settings for a personal publishing site.

use_cases.title: Publish selected Obsidian notes
use_cases.description: Prepare a public digital garden using wikilinks and page listings while excluding private material before deployment.

use_cases.title: Maintain a documentation website
use_cases.description: Structure documentation sections, manage inherited settings, and validate changes before exporting the site.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple site
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a Vowel site named [site name] with home and about pages. Ask before installation and do not deploy.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create the initial site structure.

prompt_templates.title: Add a dated blog post
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a post about [topic] dated [date] to my Vowel blog. Include a description and tags, then run vowel check.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: author content in an existing site.

prompt_templates.title: Organize a digital garden
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize [folder] as a Vowel digital garden using wikilinks, section indexes, and tag listings. Identify private content before preparing publication.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize linked notes for a public site.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an approved release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [site folder], fix validation errors, and export to [empty output folder]. Review publication scope and ask before any Cloudflare Pages deployment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: validate and prepare a controlled release.

output_examples.input: What structure should I use for a personal Vowel blog?
output: Use a homepage and a separate about page.
Add a blog index beside a folder of dated posts.
Set the site name and domain in the root settings file.
Validate the site before previewing or publishing.

output_examples.input: Can I use hidden pages for confidential project notes?
output: Hidden pages are still published; they are only omitted from listings.
Hashed URLs are not access controls.
Exclude confidential material from the published site and review publication scope before deployment.

best_practices: Run vowel check after each change and resolve every reported problem.
Prefer file-based page links so links survive URL changes.
Review publication scope and obtain explicit approval before deployment.
anti_patterns: Editing generated HTML instead of source Markdown and project stylesheets.
Treating hidden pages or hashed URLs as protection for confidential information.
Deploying a site without reviewing its content and obtaining approval.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides Vowel authoring and command-line guidance for AI assistants, not the site generator itself.

faq.question: Which runtime does Vowel require?
faq.answer: The skill specifies Node.js 26 or later and either an installed Vowel command or execution through npx.

faq.question: Can I use an Obsidian vault?
faq.answer: The skill supports preparing Markdown notes for Vowel and explains wikilinks. Review private notes before publishing any vault content.

faq.question: How do I validate site changes?
faq.answer: Run vowel check after changes. It reports problems with file locations and exits with status 1 when problems exist.

faq.question: Are hidden pages private?
faq.answer: No. Hidden pages remain published, and hashed URLs do not provide access control. Do not publish sensitive content.

faq.question: Does the skill deploy without approval?
faq.answer: Its instructions require asking before Cloudflare Pages deployment because deployment makes the site available on the web.
